en quelques instants

de la carte

Choisissez un exercice

unsure.what: All 17 header corrections are saved in the source JSON only. tools/reskin.py requires every raw capture and has no existing-screen reuse option, so the installed PNGs still contain the before text. The orchestrator must recompose all six phone frames for each of the 10 affected locales with the uniform set font size, then check the new fit, line balance and seams. The Thai headers need no changes. No app code or screenshot pixels were changed.

Raw-capture checks were intentionally skipped because raws are absent. Reviewed all 22 English/localized comparison sheets, covering all 121 configured installed frames. sheets were made with tools/sheet.py and frames.json, using Pillow only for sheet labels because Swift/CoreText is unavailable. English reference art was fetched with tools/fetch_live.py. The excluded iPad paywall was not reviewed.
